name: Coffer&Drawers
dimensions: Height 90 cm; Length 170 cm; Depth 57 cm
summary: Coffer that looks like a rectangular table with two drawers. The raised flanges at the two ends of the flat top suggest that objects were displayed on that surface. The two drawers with brass lockplates would have stored small but valuable items.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
